unique_projects_by_year = defaultdict(set)
for r in range(2, ws.max_row + 1):
    project_id = ws.cell(r, 2).value
    shipped = ws.cell(r, 3).value
    if project_id is None or shipped is None:

    year = None

        # Try to parse common date string formats if necessary
        s = str(shipped).strip()
        for fmt in ("%Y-%m-%d", "%m/%d/%Y", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d"):

                year = datetime.datetime.strptime(s, fmt).year
                break
            except ValueError:
                pass
    if year is not None:
        unique_projects_by_year[year].add(project_id)

# Fill only G2:K2 with literal counts for the years listed in G1:K1.
for col in range(7, 12):

    else:

        except (ValueError, TypeError):
